notes: Snapshot: Verdantis is a personalization & real-time ranking platform for mid-market e-commerce merchants. Low latency per-customer decisions + tight cost targets are critical.
Primary workload: per-session personalization + add-to-cart reranking + short chat helper for shoppers. Typical request payloads small (context ~120 tokens), but P99 latency requirement is strict.
Latency targets: 95th < 40ms, 99th < 75ms for P1 endpoints under production concurrencies (200 qps spiky). Throughput target: sustained 5k qps across clusters with burst to 12k qps.
Cost sensitivity: target average cost/token budget to align with current infra spend. Interested in aggressive batching and float16/int8 quantization to reduce GPU costs without quality regressions.
Model preferences: open models preferred (Llama2-13B / Mistral-like), willing to test 7B quantized variants for latency. Need model fallbacks in routing (smaller model when capacity constrained).
Security: VPC + SSO mandatory, audit logs retained for 365 days. KMS integration needed for key rotation. Data residency: primary NA but EU customers require EU residency option.
Quote from CTO (call 2026-01-28): "We can tolerate slight quality delta if it halves our GPU bill, but not if it breaks top-conversion items."

POC ask: Redwood to run a perf benchmark suite that measures tail latency under realistic prefix caching and batching; include KV cache hit-rate simulations and quantized model runs. Deliverable: CSV results + visual dashboard and config recommendation.
Redwood interest: Optimize product — suggest batching/caching/quantization profiles + benchmark harness. Dedicated for predictable throughput; evaluate Private later for EU tenancy.
Procurement note: procurement team requires SOW + security checklist before legal signs. Waiting on answers to encryption at rest and key management questions.
SE notes (Carlos): ran initial microbenchmarks 2026-02-12; 7B int8 showed 30-40% lower cost but slight ROUGE loss in rerank test. Need production prompt set to verify impact.
Handshake: demo held 2026-01-28 (product + se); follow-up run scheduled for 2026-02-14 to start automated perf sweep across three configs (hosted, dedicated baseline, dedicated + optimize).
Open technical blockers: network egress rules prevent cross-AZ KV cache warm-up in their VPC (affects cache hit rates), requires ops change or Redwood edge cache adjustment.

Next tactical: deliver benchmark plan (by 2026-03-03), schedule 72h continuous run window, collect samples for quality regression tests (conversion uplift proxy), then finalize sizing for Dedicated pods.
Timing: customer expects a vendor decision by 2026-04 to align with holiday season scaling prep.
Internal: include perf engineer (benchmarking) + solutions architect on next call; add legal contact to loop for SOW templates.
